_about: Age x race/ethnicity figures for the age selector. Schema: harm-data age-bands v1 (see README). Built from official sources; values are never imputed or pro-rated. Suppressed cells are marked suppressed.

fit_codes.exact: published band(s) add up exactly to the standard band
fit_codes.derived_exact: obtained exactly by adding/subtracting published cells (no assumptions)
fit_codes.computed_microdata: our tabulation of an official record-level file, exact ages
fit_codes.estimated: only an overlapping published band exists; the value shown is for approx_band, never pro-rated
fit_codes.unavailable: no published or computable figure for this band

race_notes: FBI "White" (SHR, NIBRS, trafficking tables) is shown as published and includes Hispanic people; Hispanic origin is a separate field.
White, non-Hispanic still includes Middle Eastern and North African origins. No US source identifies ethnic European heritage separately.
NCVS offender race is the race the victim perceived.

fbi_eht.name: FBI Expanded Homicide Data Tables (Supplementary Homicide Reports), Crime in the United States
fbi_eht.url: https://cde.ucr.cjis.gov/LATEST/webapp/#/pages/downloads (Crime in the United States Annual Reports > Expanded Homicide Tables; files expanded-homicide-YYYY.zip)
fbi_eht.coverage: Only agencies that submitted supplementary homicide data: 2024 = 15,795 victims vs 20,162 homicide deaths in CDC death records; 2025 = 13,343 victims. Not national estimates, so no rates are calculated.
